newsitem.title: USA: Selfcare glucose monitoring system cleared.
newsitem.headline: Selfcare glucose monitoring system cleared.

text.p: Selfcare Inc said it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance for its new electrochemical blood glucose monitoring system.
It said the system will be marketed by Johnson & Johnson's LifeScan Inc under agreements signed in 1996.

SelfCare said it expects shipments to LifeScan will begin late in the third quarter. Selfcare also said that the focus of the company's attention on the new system has caused delays in shipments of its generic glucose products.
As a result of these delays, Selfcare said it now expects 1997 revenues to be lower than originally expected.
The company said it expects volume shipments of generic glucose strips will not begin until late in the fourth quarter 1997.
